Luca Moretti: hi team! I'm Luca, starting today on Systems — thrilled to be here. quick Q: who should I ping for VPN + infra access?
Ivy Nguyen: welcome Luca!! @Marcus usually handles infra access for new hires. happy to give you a tour of the repo later. :wave:
Marcus Lee: hey Luca — welcome. send me your work email and I'll kick off the access forms. FYI prod access needs a manager approval flow, but dev creds are fast.
Luca Moretti: thanks Marcus — sent email. also do you know if the company MDM profile comes preinstalled or I need to enroll?
OnboardBot: Hello Luca! To enroll your device, go to https://mobility.redwood-infer/apply and follow the macOS/Windows instructions. If you hit a blocker, reply here with the error message and tag @Marcus.
Drew Patel: quick tip — if you're on mac, after enrolling you need to restart once to mount internal shares. saved me a headache.
Marcus Lee: once OnboardBot confirms your enrollment we can add you to infra groups. If you want to start early, here's a short checklist: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-infer/platform.git && make dev-setup`
Luca Moretti: perfect — running setup now. curious about team norms: standups, pager rotations?
Ivy Nguyen: we do 9:30 standup M/W/F, async updates in #eng-systems on other days. rotations are shared across Systems + SRE — you won't be alone.
Marcus Lee: also shout if you want a buddy for your first week. I can pair on setting up local infra mocks tomorrow.
Luca Moretti: would love a buddy, thanks. random fun fact: I bake sourdough and once tried to proof dough in a server cabinet (not recommended). :laughing:
Drew Patel: that is peak Systems onboarding lore :joy: welcome again!
Ivy Nguyen: welcome to Redwood, Luca — excited to work together. :tada:
